sources.researchNote: A family-history blog on the Vienna Central Cemetery, which gives Armin Lackenbach-Robinson’s dates as 23 January 1900 in Vienna to 12 September 1985 in Bad Ischl and follows his publishing career from the Wiener Bohème Verlag through his own houses in Berlin and Zurich. It names its own sources, among them the ANNO scans of Die Stunde and Die Bühne, and a portrait taken from FamilySearch. That portrait shows a man with full dark hair and no spectacles, which does not match the second figure in the Die Bühne group; neither identification can be settled from what is published.
